verdict.rationale: Qodo has its own natural-language interface: users can chat with Qodo directly inside pull requests, discuss or dismiss findings, and use "Fix with Chat Agent" to remediate issues from the conversation. Its Agentic Toolbox skills are also exposed to coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Kiro, so users can invoke review and resolution through natural-language prompts. Community comments on the Qodo Command CLI agent corroborate agentic, prompt-driven use. Missing for 10: evidence that configuration, rules and governance can be driven by natural language (these are documented only through the portal and .pr_agent.toml), detailed docs on the supported chat command scope, and independent hands-on reports of the in-PR chat experience.
